misprints.note: The smooth breathing on ολίγων is missing in the print.
No iota subscript is visible in the print.
The print clearly shows ἐξίν with an acute on the iota.
There is a full stop where a comma is expected before the termination number.
Commas are printed after the termination numbers. The same happens in 'ἀνισομήκης, 2, ἀνισοπλατής'.
Under Oljepress the print reads 'qvarn' with no umlaut, so I kept it as printed.

uncertain.note: The letter after πε is faint and looks like ι or τ. I read τ (δρυπετής, the attested word).
The diacritic above the iota in 'τῶν ολίγων εἷς' is small. It could be εἶς or εἷς.
